BaselineState: Azure MFA was not required for activation.
ImplementedState: Azure MFA is required for activation.
ValidationMethod: Post-change role-policy review and PIM alert rescan
ResidualRisk: Role use still depends on the strength and protection of registered authentication methods.

BaselineState: Maximum activation duration was eight hours.
ImplementedState: Maximum activation duration is two hours.
ResidualRisk: A shorter duration does not prevent misuse during an approved active window.

ImplementedState: Justification and ticket information are required.
ValidationMethod: Post-change role-policy review and completed request workflow
ResidualRisk: PIM records supplied context but does not independently validate the external ticket.

BaselineState: Approval was not required and no approver was configured.
ImplementedState: Approval is required and two member approvers are configured.
ResidualRisk: Approval quality still depends on reviewer diligence.

ImplementedState: Permanent eligible assignments are disabled and eligibility expires after six months.
ResidualRisk: Later milestones must validate renewal and extension decisions.

ImplementedState: Permanent active assignments are disabled and administrator-created active assignments expire after one month.
ResidualRisk: Exceptional active assignments require separate review.

BaselineState: No controlled User Administrator eligibility was in the Milestone 2 test scope.
ImplementedState: One direct directory-scoped eligible assignment exists from 15 September 2026 through 14 March 2027.
ResidualRisk: Eligibility remains usable during its approved six-month window.

BaselineState: Immediate activation was possible under the default policy.
ImplementedState: The submitted activation request remained pending until reviewed by a separate approver.
ResidualRisk: Delegated approvers must remain available within the request window.

BaselineState: No active assignment was expected before approval.
ImplementedState: Approved User Administrator access was active with a two-hour end time and a Deactivate action.
ResidualRisk: Application authorization caches can delay recognition of assignment changes.

ImplementedState: A disabled unlicensed synthetic user was created during the active window and deleted immediately after validation.
ResidualRisk: The task was intentionally minimal and is not a substitute for production user acceptance testing.

BaselineState: No completed Milestone 2 activation cycle existed.
ImplementedState: The role was manually deactivated and the audit history recorded the assignment request approval activation and deactivation sequence.
ResidualRisk: PIM audit history has a limited portal retention window.

BaselineState: The activation-MFA alert identified Directory Readers.
ImplementedState: The activation-MFA alert cleared; the separate Global Administrator count alert remained open.
ResidualRisk: Global Administrator remediation is deferred to Milestone 3.
